source_record.title: Non-executable script modes break the default test suite on faithful checkouts
source_record.claim: Two scripts that production paths execute directly are committed with git mode 100644, so `cargo test -p opi-eval --all-targets` (and therefore the workspace union and the CI test job) fails on any checkout whose filesystem honors git modes; recorded phase-exit gate PASSes were masked by the all-executable DrvFs working tree.

evidence.location: crates/opi-eval/scripts/scripted-provider.py (git mode 100644; was 100755 until commit c8d6dea renamed phase18-scripted-provider.py with mode drop)
evidence.detail: src/cli/conformance.rs:338 helper executes $OPI_EVAL_SCRIPTED_PROVIDER directly; EACCES leaves conformance-provider-response empty and the provider-fixture case settles provider-fixture-response-drift with met:false.
src/runner/prepare.rs:930 invokes the seeded copy via Command::new; supervised_acquisition_runs_the_pinned_materializer fails with 'Permission denied (os error 13)'.

agent_conformance_matrix_settles_every_pinned_case FAILED (opi provider-fixture, exit 1) and supervised_acquisition_runs_the_pinned_materializer FAILED (Some(2) vs Some(0)); reproduced twice plus a direct CLI reproduction.
Both files appear rwxrwxrwx regardless of git mode, which is how the ledger's scoped-smoke and 19.11 'smoke full PASSED' records were produced without exposing the defect.

reproduction: git archive ad67cb8 | tar -x -C <dir> && cd <dir> && cargo test -p opi-eval --all-targets --no-fail-fast
git ls-files -s crates/opi-eval/scripts/scripted-provider.py crates/opi-eval/tests/fixtures/external-locks/local-cache/scripts/materialize-external-locks.sh

current_evidence: Exact committed archive modes are 0755 for both scripts; inputs/executable-modes.json records them.
Fresh ext4 conformance passes 2 tests; current native_driver passes the supervised acquisition regression. This refutes the mode defect only; final workspace gates remain under B3.

final_severity_rationale: Retain Major: current official witnesses delete successful evidence roots. Universal historical absence is not established or inferred.
red_before_not_applicable: Test-only retention and native verification; no production/model failure is invented. Current static retention failure is separately recorded.

green_after.command: cargo test -p opi-eval --locked --test native_driver native_tb21_artifact_witness -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1; cargo test -p opi-eval --locked --test native_driver native_tb3_artifact_witness -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1; cargo test -p opi-eval --locked --test native_driver native_deepswe_patch_witness -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1
green_after.expected: All three official families pass with their own verified material. Success/failure roots survive; retained commands, native jobs, rewards and artifact hashes prove required correct/incorrect contrasts without remote inference.
green_after.observed: NOT EXECUTED: dependency B1 failed its real cold-preparation predicate on missing integrity in the pinned pi shrinkwrap. No native witness, independent replay, or final workspace gate is claimed. Planned production/test/documentation paths for this batch were not edited.

source_record.title: No durable evidence that per-family correct/incorrect artifact witnesses ran through the real native graders
source_record.claim: The registered mechanical verification routes for P19-AC-003/004/005 require a controlled correct/incorrect artifact witness through the same production handoff and the real pinned native grader; no executed witness run is recorded anywhere in the committed handoff, the operator evidence root, or CI dispatch records, so the 13/13 phase-exit closure overstates these criteria.

evidence.detail: native_tb21_artifact_witness / native_tb3_artifact_witness / native_deepswe_patch_witness are ignored filters requiring OPI_EVAL_NATIVE_WITNESS_MATERIAL plus Docker; no run of them is recorded in the phase19 ledger, the acceptance docs, or the operator workspace.

evidence.location: phase19 operator evidence root (manifest schema opi-eval-local-acceptance/1)
evidence.detail: Manifest keys builds/command_exits/controls/material/operator/opi_repository/preserved/sources/trials contain zero witness, conformance, or oracle entries.

evidence.location: .github/workflows/opi-eval-native-smoke.yml (conformance-rerun runs oracle-witness and nop-witness for all three families)
evidence.detail: The workflow is manually dispatched; no dispatch, artifact, or receipt for it is committed, so it cannot serve as executed witness evidence.

Six real trials graded tb21 1/1 and tb30/deepswe 0/0; there is no within-family correct/incorrect contrast, so grader sensitivity to artifact variation remains unproven by the real graders (deterministic stand-in-verifier witnesses pass but do not exercise the pinned graders).

reproduction: grep -ri witness docs/snapshots/phase19/opi-impl-state.json docs/audits/phase19-local-native-acceptance*.md; python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/mnt/d/Luiz/Odradek/phase19-operator/evidence-root/manifest.json')).keys())"
OPI_EVAL_NATIVE_WITNESS_MATERIAL=<resolved material> cargo test -p opi-eval --test native_driver native_tb21_artifact_witness -- --ignored (and the tb3/deepswe siblings)

current_evidence: Current source bodies/hashes are retained in /tmp/opi-p19-replan-k4zbchfg/inputs/witness-source-observations.json.
Existing production conformance entrypoints and official family identities are retained; controlled lifecycle fixtures cannot substitute for these contrasts.

red_before.command: Inspect the three official witness bodies in the exact archive using Appendix B.
red_before.expected: Successful official-family witness roots and attributable raw outputs survive process exit.
red_before.observed: FAIL (static): native_tb21_artifact_witness, native_tb3_artifact_witness and native_deepswe_patch_witness at lines 2253/2302/2375 remove their roots after successful assertions. All remain ignored in the current default run; historical evidence absence was not investigated.

scope_rationale: B1 public cold preparation directly spawns the production materializer. Its committed 100644 mode produces FailedToSpawn PermissionDenied on the faithful ext4 archive. Only that executable bit changes; script bytes and every producer digest remain unchanged. This is necessary within the B1 acquisition causal surface and does not authorize changing the subsequently failing pi archive admission.

red_before.expected: FAIL: direct invocation of the faithfully seeded production script is denied.
red_before.observed: FAIL: exit 1 with PermissionError errno 13. Public prepare independently reports FailedToSpawn PermissionDenied; logs/i1-executable-red.json and materials/tb21-cold/acquisition.log retain both observations.

green_after.expected: PASS: the production entry executes an empty acquisition plan without changing material.
green_after.observed: PASS: exit 0 after 100644 -> 100755 only. logs/i1-executable-green.json and inputs/i1-mode-proof.json bind identical script content SHA256 a46e7ab7beafef95e70990da0f290bda1c2da59513b90f105018d00bc4ace8e3. The next public replay reaches the real Opi and pi builders.
